from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """An expense line item extracted from a company's financial statements."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing this statement")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this expense covers")
    line_item_label: str = Field(description="The exact text label of the expense line as it appears in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for this line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_records: list[ExpenseRecord]
